title: Anecdoctoring: Automated Red-Teaming Across Language and Place

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of large language models when responding to adversarial disinformation prompts across different languages, specifically examining safety disparities between English, Spanish, and Hindi.

Evaluating the effectiveness of model safety guardrails across different geographical contexts by generating and testing adversarial attacks grounded in location-specific misinformation narratives from the United States and India.
